items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I took trumpet lessons with Shalini.

ctx.x: So that dates his life. Where did you learn to play? What was your first instrument? Who? What was your first instrument? What did you start on?

My dad had started me but he couldn't look like he had no patience to learn to teach me. He sent me to his friend Old Man Shalini. Oh yeah. And I took trumpet lessons. On the trumpet. I took trumpet lessons with Shalini.
